classification.zh: 总部直管、驻外国家销售总经理规划；成本及目标为建议测算，不代表已发生费用、薪酬要约或客户承诺。
classification.en: HQ-managed country sales GM plan. Costs and goals are authored assumptions, not incurred expenses, a compensation offer or customer commitments.

budget_rows.zh: 基本工资
每月6,000美元；全年12个月
雇主缴费预留
每月1,000美元；不含下列医疗/居留，按适用制度替换
budget_rows.en: USD1,000/month excluding medical / residence below; replace under applicable rules

budget_rows.zh: 驻外住宿及基础公用支出
每月2,000美元；按实际租约报销或封顶
budget_rows.en: USD2,000/month; actual lease or capped allowance

budget_rows.zh: 驻地交通
每月600美元；车辆、停车等，不重复报本地交通
budget_rows.en: USD600/month for vehicle / parking; no duplicate local claims

budget_rows.zh: 医疗、居留与许可规费预留
每月300美元；按获批路径列正式费用
budget_rows.en: USD300/month allowance; use actual approved route / fees

budget_rows.zh: 通信与工作工具
每月100美元
总部述职与探亲机票
每年2次往返，每次2,000美元；区域客户差旅另列
budget_rows.en: Two return trips at USD2,000 each; Gulf client travel separate

budget_rows.zh: 首次外派安置
首年一次性5,000美元；搬迁、设备等；可退押金另列
budget_rows.en: USD5,000 in Y1 for relocation / equipment; refundable deposit separate

budget_rows.zh: 海湾客户差旅
Y1按6次×2,000美元；机票、住宿与当地接驳
budget_rows.en: Y1: six trips × USD2,000 for travel, hotel and transfers

budget_rows.zh: 客户工作会与阿语支持
Y1每月500美元；有议题、有记录
budget_rows.en: Y1: USD500/month for defined, documented meetings

budget_rows.zh: 小型行业交流与演示
Y1两场×3,000美元；服务具名客户，不做泛投放
budget_rows.en: Y1: two × USD3,000 for named-account engagement

budget_rows.zh: 客户材料与场景样例
Y1五个工作包×1,000美元
驻外用工、税务与合同咨询
按次采购；含驻外活动、常设机构及合同审阅
budget_rows.en: Case-based advice on activities, PE exposure and contracts

budget_rows.zh: PRO按件支持
服务费；政府规费已在个人成本中预留
budget_rows.en: Service fees; official permit charges in personal costs

budget_rows.zh: 合规雇佣或代雇服务预留
按获批雇佣方式使用；不含已列工资、保险和规费
budget_rows.en: Use for the approved arrangement; excludes wages, insurance and official fees above

budget_rows.zh: 总部非计费售前
Y1为12个有效人周×3,000美元；付费项目工时另计
budget_rows.en: Y1: 12 effective person-weeks × USD3,000; paid delivery separate

scope.zh: 一个业务问题、流程与数据基线、下一阶段SOW；约2个有效周，客户日历4-8周。
scope.en: One problem, workflow / data baseline and next-stage SOW; about two active weeks across 4-8 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一种凭证、两类参与方、最多3个接口和一个测试流程；约6个技术周，客户日历8-16周。
scope.en: One credential, two roles, up to three interfaces and one test workflow; about six technical weeks across 8-16 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一个运营主体、一个流程、最多3个既有系统接口；24人周，客户日历基线4个月。
scope.en: One operator, one workflow and up to three existing-system interfaces; 24 person-weeks over a four-month baseline.

scope.zh: 每个上线项目每月1个人日工作日窗口支持700美元，加云/监测200美元；额外支持另报价。
scope.en: Per live project: one business-day support at USD700 plus USD200 cloud / monitoring per month; price additional work separately.

assumptions.zh: 工资福利用于公司全成本评价；若已在总部原有人事预算内且无新增替补，才可另看新增投入。新聘岗位用全成本。
assumptions.en: Use salary / benefits for full-cost evaluation. The incremental view applies only if existing HQ payroll remains budgeted with no replacement hire. A new hire uses full cost.

assumptions.zh: 诊断、试点、生产分别计价，收入在验收时列入规划，服务按月列入；报价若含前期费用抵扣，应在合同及模型中扣一次。
assumptions.en: Discovery, pilot and production are separately priced. Plan revenue at acceptance and support monthly. Deduct any scoping credit once in contract and model.

assumptions.zh: 实施期直接成本费用化，用于呈现售前到回款的资金压力；实际确认按合同与适用会计规则。
assumptions.en: Expense delivery during implementation in this management model; actual recognition follows contracts and applicable accounting.

assumptions.zh: 激励建议按验收且收款部分对应的计划毛利5%计提，次月支付；实际以扣除超支、退款、渠道费后的核定毛利结算。
assumptions.en: Illustrative incentive: accrue 5% of planned margin attributable to accepted, paid scope, payable next month. Settle on verified margin after overruns, refunds and channel fees.

assumptions.zh: 合同收入不等于行业成交额、平台流水或客户资产规模。项目签约额不含可按月取消的后续服务。
assumptions.en: Revenue excludes transaction volume, platform flows and customer asset values. Project bookings exclude cancellable monthly support.

assumptions.zh: 个人工资、市场费用、非计费售前与付费交付工时分开；本版没有当地工程师工资扣回。
assumptions.en: Separate personal compensation, sales spend, non-billable presales and paid delivery. No resident-engineer cost credit applies.

assumptions.zh: 整体延期6个月时，项目、服务和付款一起后移；人员与销售预算保持，不预先假设节流成功。
assumptions.en: A six-month slip moves scope, support and receipts together. Staffing / sales budgets continue without assumed savings.

assumptions.zh: 15%预留与流动性缓冲是两种资金视角，不重复相加。2,000美元可退住宿押金是现金占用，不是费用。
assumptions.en: The 15% reserve and liquidity buffer are alternative funding views. The USD2,000 refundable housing deposit uses cash but is not an expense.

assumptions.zh: 本模型为税前销售贡献，未计总部全部行政管理分摊、所得税、VAT及法定资金；适用时据实际补充。
assumptions.en: This is pre-tax sales contribution, before unallocated HQ corporate overhead, income tax, VAT and statutory funding; add as applicable.

assumptions.zh: 没有取得个人已发生费用账单、布比历史实际营收或总部真实成本；所有新增金额标为H40规划输入。
assumptions.en: No personal expense claims, actual historical BUBIX revenue or actual HQ cost accounts are available. All new monetary inputs are H40 planning assumptions.
